ns2:section.sectionText: An introduction to the taxonomic groups, identification, and natural history of the vertebrates and invertebrates that inhabit and form coral reefs. Ecosystem processes and conservation of coral reefs will also be discussed. One 1 hour lecture per week plus the week-long field trip to Belize at the end of the semester. Cost of the field trip is estimated to be $1450 and will be borne by the student. Prerequisite: IB 150 and consent of instructor. Student must be able to swim.
